kind: gen_input (VASP input set + generated interface structure)
_doc: Ground truth is the constructed RuO2/SnTe interface and a reconstructed intended relax/static input deck. No completed SOC DFT result validates these settings at the meV scale. An original step-1 attempt was cancelled; its spatial Ru magnetic pattern agrees with the corrected reference. The reference is not an as-run successful DFT deck.
provenance: Geometry: 3_reproduction/L2/references/POSCAR_RuO2_SnTe110 (auditor build guards). Input rubric: 3_reproduction/L2/task.txt with user-approved self-review corrections to spatial magnetism and accepted equivalent settings. No completed DFT calculation is claimed.

structure_match.termination_convention: The bottom RuO2 plane adjacent to SnTe has each Ru's two nearest coplanar O neighbors along the prompt's y axis. This human-approved reproduction geometry is fixed in the prompt; the alternative film termination is excluded. Lateral registry remains free.
structure_match.method_reason: Two-block species-aware matching within 0.1 A: a common rigid 3D translation aligns the Sn/Te substrate, then one lateral translation aligns Ru/O. A one-to-one site correspondence transfers spatial Ru sublattice and bottom-fixed-region labels. Atom permutations, periodic wrapping, rigid translations and free film registry are accepted; the declared termination and normal interface separation remain fixed.
structure_match.applies_to: both runs (relax and static share the same POSCAR)

poscar.fixed_note: The bottom 20 SnTe planes (80 Sn + 80 Te) are FFF; every coordinate of every other atom is TTT. Labels follow the geometric mapping, not submitted atom indices.

kmesh_reference.note: As-run reproduction mesh provenance. Grading uses the separate frozen kmesh_policy; centering and vacuum requirements remain independent.

encut.rule: ENCUT >= the largest ENMAX over Sn_d, Te, Ru_pv, O = 400 eV (O; the pseudopotential's own floor)
encut.reason: ENMAX sourced from the POTCAR headers of the VASP 5.4 PBE library (Ru_pv 230.429, O 400.000, Sn_d 241.090, Te 174.982 eV); the shared grader catalog carries them. task.txt fixes ENCUT=520 eV (the atomate2 MP-consistent value), comfortably above the 400 eV floor; the prompt no longer prints it (5.2a), and the agent catalog now carries the ENMAX values.

incar_required._note: Each rule applies to the effective value: the tag if explicitly set, else the VASP default. Only the settings listed here are graded; the per-tag reasoning is in notes.md.

shared_both_runs.ENCUT: >= the largest ENMAX over Sn_d, Te, Ru_pv, O = 400 eV (the pseudopotential's own floor; the agent derives it from the ENMAX values now listed in agent/potcar_catalog.yaml -- the prompt no longer pins a number)
shared_both_runs.IDIPOL: 3 (dipole along the z slab normal; default 0)
shared_both_runs.LDAUTYPE: 2 (Dudarev; default 2 -- in-set, omitted passes; LDAUTYPE=1 fails)
shared_both_runs.MAGMOM: Mapped rutile Ru sublattices alternate between adjacent c/2 planes, with opposite moments along one common Neel axis; either global sign and any common static axis are accepted. Ru magnitudes >=0.3 uB, other magnitudes <=0.1 uB; net Ru moment <=half the sum of magnitudes (existing initialization bounds).
shared_both_runs.kmesh: Frozen automatic-default minima from kmesh_policy, with the separately specified centering, vacuum and method constraints.
shared_both_runs.U_eff_Ru: Dudarev U-J in [2.7,3.3] eV on Ru with LDAUL=2; other species LDAUL=-1 and U=J=0. Per-species arrays follow POSCAR block order; omitted LDAUJ defaults to zero.

relax_only.LSORBIT: effectively .FALSE. (collinear relax, no SOC; default .FALSE., so omitting passes; LSORBIT=.TRUE. fails)
relax_only.relax_fixed_cell: ISIF in {0,1,2}, IBRION in {1,2,3}, NSW positive integer, EDIFFG<0 and |EDIFFG|<=0.05 eV/A
relax_only.LNONCOLLINEAR: effectively false (default follows LSORBIT); scalar MAGMOM per atom
relax_only.ISMEAR: Fermi-Dirac -1, Gaussian 0 or Methfessel-Paxton 1/2; omitted value defaults to 1

static_only.static: NSW effectively 0 (default 0, so omitting passes) or IBRION=-1
static_only.LNONCOLLINEAR: effectively true (default follows LSORBIT); three MAGMOM components per atom
static_only.ISMEAR: Fermi-Dirac -1, Gaussian 0 or Methfessel-Paxton 1/2; tetrahedron -5 only with existing integration-mesh support (at least two subdivisions on at least two axes for automatic meshes). Default 1.

score: 1 only if both runs (relax, static) pass the structure match AND their per-run REQUIRED INCAR/KPOINTS rubric (all checks must pass; any single failure scores 0)
format: answer.json root and runs must be objects; both required run paths must be nonempty strings. Basic schema failures return score 0.

kmesh_policy.source: Trusted reference input cell per run label; geometry-based density shared by VASP, QE and ABACUS. No inference from submitted settings.
kmesh_policy.rule: Each periodic-axis subdivision >= automatic default, without subtraction or relative margin. Vacuum axes are exactly 1. Berry strings retain their independent longitudinal condition.
